source: Mini toggle switch MTS-102 datasheet (generalize/plan.json datasheet_note): 6.0 mm (1/4 in) bushing, lever 12 mm above the panel, body 13 x 8 x 10 mm, panel up to 4 mm. ASSUMED: bushing length above the body 8.0 mm, lever 3.0 mm dia, lever swing 4.0 mm radius at its tip (about +/-20 degrees), nut 9.0 mm across corners, 3 solder lugs at 4.7 mm pitch along the 13 mm side.
frame: panel switch: origin at the body min corner, body bottom at Z = 0, bushing and lever toward +Z, solder lugs toward -Z; bushing axis at the body centre

body_height.source: datasheet: body Z (seat to the bushing shoulder)

bushing_diameter.source: datasheet: 6.0 mm (1/4 in class) bushing; M6 x 0.75 thread

bushing_length.source: ASSUMED bushing length above the body; +/- 1.0

lever_height.source: datasheet: lever height above the panel/bushing face

lever_swing_radius.source: ASSUMED lever tip swing radius (about +/-20 deg of a 12 mm lever); +/- 1.0

pin_pitch.source: ASSUMED lug pitch for an MTS-102 (3 lugs); +/- 0.3

lug_length.source: ASSUMED solder lug length below the body

mount.notes: the panel hole is the bushing diameter plus rules clearance; the bushing is clamped by the nut, panel plane between SHOULDER and BUSHING_TOP

notes: Datasheet 'lever 12 mm above the panel' is read as the lever length above the bushing face (the panel face sits about one panel thickness below BUSHING_TOP). Bushing seat/nut contact is designed contact. ASSUMPTIONS and uncertainty: bushing length 8.0 (+/-1.0) must exceed panel 4.0 + nut thickness ~2.0, check with the owner's part; lever 3.0 dia is a mean of the tapered lever; swing radius 4.0 (+/-1.0) approximates a +/-20 degree throw; lugs 3 at 4.7 pitch (a 2P ON-OFF variant has 2); nut 9.0 across corners. Import gate: body bounding box 13 x 8 x 10; lever tip above the bushing top.

self_checks.name: bushing axis at the body centre X
bushing long enough for panel and nut (panel 4 + nut ~2)
